python -c "
import numpy as np

# Load and verify the distribution
dist = np.load('/app/dist.npy')
print(f'Distribution shape: {dist.shape}')
print(f'Sum of probabilities: {np.sum(dist):.12f}')
print(f'Max probability: {np.max(dist):.8f}')
print(f'Min probability: {np.min(dist):.15f}')
print(f'All probabilities positive: {np.all(dist > 0)}')

# Calculate KL divergences
def forward_kl(p, u):
    epsilon = 1e-15
    p_safe = np.maximum(p, epsilon)
    u_safe = np.maximum(u, epsilon)
    return np.sum(p * np.log(p_safe / u_safe))

def backward_kl(p, u):
    epsilon = 1e-15
    p_safe = np.maximum(p, epsilon)
    u_safe = np.maximum(u, epsilon)
    return np.sum(u * np.log(u_safe / p_safe))

u = np.ones(150000) / 150000
fkl = forward_kl(dist, u)
bkl = backward_kl(dist, u)

print(f'\\nKL divergences:')
print(f'Forward KL(P||U): {fkl:.6f}')
print(f'Backward KL(U||P): {bkl:.6f}')
print(f'Target: 10.000000')
print(f'Forward error: {abs(fkl - 10.0):.6f}')
print(f'Backward error: {abs(bkl - 10.0):.6f}')
print(f'Within tolerance (0.001): {abs(fkl - 10.0) <= 0.001 and abs(bkl - 10.0) <= 0.001}')
"
